ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   D. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

6. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)

   D. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.

   A. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)

   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   B. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   C. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.

----
